# Parse the CSV data we already have, handling \r in status
lines = csv_content.strip().split('\n')
headers = [h.strip() for h in lines[0].split(',')]

        amount = int(row['amount'])
        total_won += amount
        won_deals.append(row)

# Summary
print(f"=== Meridian Analytics — Q3 2026 Won Deals ===\n")
print(f"{'Deal ID':<10} {'Rep':<20} {'Region':<8} {'Product':<25} {'Amount':>10} {'Close Date':<12}")

for d in won_deals:

print("-" * 90)
print(f"{'TOTAL WON DEALS:':<65} ${total_won:>9,}")
print(f"\nTotal won deals: {len(won_deals)} out of {len(lines)-1} total deals")
